call.x: Apply for funding to increase our understanding, assessment, management, and governance of water across scales, from catchment to groundwater and from source to sea. Enable better decision-making for public authorities, water managers, and other stakeholders.
n: Run by Natural Environment Research Council (NERC) , Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC). The organiser sets the rules; Eligible Calls reads this call from UKRI Funding Finder (ukri.org).

UKRI-water4all-2026-call-sustainable-wat.heading: How we will assess your application

blocks.text: You should refer to the Water4All website for full details on how your application will be assessed.
The assessment process will be led by the Water4All. Your application will be assessed by independent experts in a two stage process:
At step 1 (pre-proposal stage): (1) Excellence and (2) Impact
At step 2 (full proposal stage): (1) Excellence, (2) Impact and (3) Quality and Efficiency of Implementation

conditions.quote: International researchers To be eligible for the Water4All 2026 joint call, transnational research consortia must include team members from a minimum of three countries financially participating in the funding opportunity.

HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
